title: Elux Legend Blueberry Bubblegum Nic Salt E-Liquid 10ml
description: Elux Legend's Blueberry Bubblegum Nic Salt is a delightful fusion of succulent ripe blueberries and the sweetness of bubblegum candy. This e-liquid delivers a nostalgic and enjoyable vaping experience that combines the lusciousness of blueberries with the playfulness of bubblegum. The initial inhale presents the rich and juicy flavour of ripe blueberries, offering a sweet and slightly tart profile reminiscent of summer. This is artfully complemented by the smooth and sugary notes of bubblegum candy, creating a symphony of delightful tastes. Blueberry Bubblegum is the ideal choice for vapers seeking a blend that's both fruity and nostalgically sweet. Our Elux Legend Nic Salts e-liquids are available in 10mg or 20mg nicotine strength, making them ideal for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking immediate and satisfying nicotine relief provided by nic salts. Each flavour is carefully crafted using premium ingredients, ensuring a clean and authentic taste that tantalizes your taste buds with each puff. Elux Legend Nic Salts e-liquids provide a smoother and more satisfying hit than traditional freebase nicotine as nicotine salts are absorbed into the bloodstream faster, allowing for a quick and efficient nicotine delivery without any harshness or throat irritation. The Elux Legend Nic Salts are designed for use with pod systems and other low-wattage devices, providing a more concentrated and flavourful vaping experience. They are the perfect choice for vapers seeking a high-quality, smooth, and satisfying nicotine hit coupled with incredible flavours. Try the Elux Legend Nic Salts line today and experience the next level of vaping satisfaction.
